text: Can you name all fifty?
DC edition. Seven seconds each. Ready? Go!
Number one. Who's this?
Batman! He trained for years on every continent.
Easy one. Who is this?
Superman! Sold for just a hundred thirty bucks.
Name this legend.
Wonder Woman! Created by a psychologist.
Who's in the shadow?
The Flash! He runs at nearly light speed.
Can you name this one?
Aquaman! He talks to sea life with his mind.
Who's hiding in the dark?
Green Lantern! His ring runs on pure willpower.
Getting tougher. Who is it?
Black Adam! Kahndaq's champion for five thousand years.
You've got this. Who is it?
The Joker! Even his origin story keeps changing.
Who's this mystery hero?
Martian Manhunter! He reads minds, but fears fire.
Number ten. Who's looming here?
Darkseid! His Omega Beams never miss.
Bonus round! Whose eyes are these?
Killer Frost! Her touch freezes almost anything solid.
Think you know this one?
Nightwing! The first Robin, all grown up.
Hard one. Who is it?
Booster Gold! He stole his suit from a museum.
Name the shadow.
Supergirl! She remembers Krypton. Clark doesn't.
Okay, who is this?
Poison Ivy! Her kiss is lethal.
Tough one. Name it.
John Constantine! He's outsmarted the Devil three times.
Warm-up! Who's this?
Harley Quinn! A cartoon star since nineteen ninety-two.
Name this one.
Deathstroke! A serum boosted his brain power.
Brace yourself. Who's this?
Starfire! She absorbs sunlight and fires starbolts.
Hard one. Name it.
Beast Boy! He can morph into any animal.
Number twenty. Who is this?
Cyborg! His own dad rebuilt him as a machine.
Bonus! Whose weapon is this?
Red Hood! The second Robin, back from the dead.
Who's this? Think fast.
Ra's al Ghul! The Lazarus Pit keeps him alive.
Only true fans know this.
Blue Beetle! His alien armor has a mind of its own.
Tricky one. Who is it?
Swamp Thing! A plant that thinks it's human.
Easy one. Name him.
Green Arrow! His trick arrows include a boxing glove.
Twenty-five! Who is this?
Two-Face! He used to be Gotham's District Attorney.
Halfway there! How many did you get? Drop your score in the comments.
Hard one. Who's this?
Lobo! The Main Man wiped out his own species.
Take a guess.
Plastic Man! A crook who turned good.
Easy points! Who's this?
Catwoman! Created as Batman's love interest.
Who's in the shadow?
The Riddler! He can't resist leaving clues.
Number thirty. Who's this?
Doctor Fate! His helmet holds an ancient Lord of Order.
Bonus! Name the half shadow.
Firestorm! Two people fuse into one hero.
Tough one. Who's this?
The Atom! He shrinks using white dwarf star matter.
Easy one. Who is it?
Lex Luthor! He's even been U.S. President.
Okay, this one's tricky.
Mister Freeze! He can only survive in extreme cold.
Only real fans get this.
Killer Croc! He was born with scales.
Who's this? Go!
Scarecrow! A psychologist who weaponized fear.
Think hard. Who is this?
Bane! He read every book in his prison.
Brutal one. Who is it?
Doomsday! He adapts to whatever kills him.
Quick! Who is this?
Robin! Damian Wayne, Batman's own son.
Hard one. Who's hiding here?
Etrigan! A rhyming demon bound by Merlin.
Number forty. Who's this?
Bizarro! He speaks in opposites.
Final stretch! Beat your score so far, and comment it below.
Bonus! Which one is fake?
The real Sinestro is on the left!
Who's in the shadow?
Zatanna! She casts spells by talking backwards.
Stay sharp. Who's this?
Metallo! A kryptonite heart powers him.
Hard one. Name it.
Mister Miracle! He escaped Apokolips.
Easy points! Name this hero.
Shazam! A kid becomes the mightiest mortal.
Can you name this one?
Black Canary! Her scream is a sonic weapon.
Tough one. Take a guess.
Brainiac! He shrank and bottled an entire city.
Who's this? Go!
Hawkman! A warrior reborn across the centuries.
Name the shadow.
Deadshot! He never misses his target.
Almost there. Who is it?
Raven! Half demon, powered by her soul.
Final question. Who's this?
The Spectre! A detective fused with an angel.
Bonus! Who's this blur?
Kid Flash! Same lightning accident as his mentor.
How many did you get? Fifty or more makes you a Legend. Under seventeen? Civilian. Comment your score, and subscribe for more hero quizzes!
